derivationRule: hand: the expected lexical outcome (token classes and texts, inserted ';', error code and the defect position) is written by hand in this file; spans are located by searching the hand-written token text in source order; k-gram hashes, window selections and fingerprints are computed from it
lexingCheck: Token streams are hand-derived; check_vectors.py re-verifies lexical invariants and harness/crosscheck.py compares them with go/scanner, proc-macro2 and rustc.

vectors.description: Empty input: zero tokens, no k-grams.
Four tokens (including the semicolon inserted at the final newline) is fewer than k=5.
Exactly k=5 tokens: one k-gram, partial window selects it.
Unicode letters in identifiers, multi-byte string and rune literals; spans are UTF-8 byte offsets.
vectors.inputText: päivä := "héllo, 世界" + 名前 + string('☃')

vectors.description: Numeric literal forms, raw string spanning a newline (no insertion inside it), interpreted string escapes.
No insertion after ',' at line end; a general comment containing a newline and a final line comment each act as a newline.
Ten identical tokens: all k-grams identical, every window ties, rightmost minimum wins; duplicate hashes at distinct positions are all retained.
Period-3 token sequence: every window of 4 contains a repeated k-gram, so ties on the minimum are guaranteed.
Reference for the comment/whitespace pair.
Same tokens as go-format-a with different comments and whitespace and no final newline; fingerprint hashes must be identical.
Reference for the rename pair.
vectors.inputText: func add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

vectors.description: Identifiers renamed: exact hashes differ, normalized hashes equal go-rename-a.
vectors.inputText: func sum(x, y int) int { return x + y }

vectors.description: Byte 0xFF inside a string literal: invalid UTF-8, rejected before lexing.
Leading UTF-8 byte order mark: rejected (stricter than go/scanner, which skips it).
NUL character: rejected.
Newline before the closing quote of an interpreted string.
General comment never closed.
'#' does not begin any Go token.
Hex prefix without digits.
Unknown escape \q in an interpreted string; offset is the literal start.
Identifier boundary code points accepted by Go: U+2E2F VERTICAL TILDE is Lm (a letter), U+0660 is Nd (a digit, allowed after the first character), '_' alone is an identifier.
U+2160 ROMAN NUMERAL ONE is Nl, not a Go letter: illegal character (Rust accepts it).
U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT is Po: illegal in Go identifiers (Rust XID_Continue accepts it).
U+0345 COMBINING YPOGEGRAMMENI is Mn: illegal in Go (Rust XID_Continue accepts it).
U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER is Cf: illegal in Go.
U+0660 (Nd) cannot start an identifier and does not start a number.
U+FEFF after offset 0 is rejected by the forbidden-code-point scan.
Hex mantissa with '.' but no 'p' exponent matches no literal production.
CR inside a raw string is kept in the exact token text (OD-9); go/scanner strips it from its literal value.
Q9: U+0378 is unassigned (not in go_letter): illegal character. The assigned table is informative only.
Q11: '0b2i' matches no production (0b2 is not int_lit or decimal_digits): malformed. go/scanner accepts; cmd/compile rejects.
Q11: '0o9i' likewise malformed.
Q12: '/*line :*/' is an ordinary general comment (section 4.6): zero tokens. go/scanner rejects it as an invalid line directive.
Interpreted string with \x escape and a raw string containing U+000B (exercises the cross-check harness quoting fix).
Paired rejection of go-empty: the empty input replaced by a lone UTF-8 BOM.
Paired rejection of go-exact-k: '@' (no Go token starts with it) appended to the last line.
Paired rejection of go-unicode: the rune literal holds two snowmen.
vectors.inputText: päivä := "héllo, 世界" + 名前 + string('☃☃')

vectors.description: Paired rejection of go-literals: hex float exponent without digits (0x1p).
